title: Reference Architectures & Patterns — Failure Injection & Auto-Healing
purpose: Simulates regional database network partition: illustrates Cloud Spanner automatic Paxos quorum failover with zero data loss.
routing_rationale: Cloud Spanner maintains external consistency and zero RPO by requiring a majority quorum of voting replicas across 3 regions before committing any transaction.

nodes.label: Spanner Leader (us-central1)
nodes.detail: Coordinates transaction 2-phase commits and local read locks.

nodes.label: GKE App Pods (us-central1)
nodes.detail: Routes database reads and writes to local Spanner leader node.

nodes.label: Spanner Paxos Replica (us-east1)
nodes.detail: Replicates write logs and votes on transaction commit consensus.

nodes.label: Witness Region (us-west1)
nodes.detail: Participates in voting without storing full persistent database data.

steps.title: Transaction Propose
steps.action: GKE sends write transaction to local Spanner leader node in us-central1.
steps.why_traversal: Clients communicate directly with the Paxos leader for low-latency writes.

steps.title: Paxos Consensus Round
steps.action: Leader replicates write log to us-east1 and witness in us-west1 to obtain 2/3 majority.
steps.why_traversal: Majority agreement guarantees durability before acknowledgment.

scenarios.label: Total us-central1 Regional Blackout
scenarios.root_cause: Catastrophic fiber cut isolates entire us-central1 Google data center facility.
scenarios.diverted_path: us-east1 replica and us-west1 witness elect us-east1 as new Paxos leader in < 5 seconds.
scenarios.blast_radius: Zero data loss (RPO = 0); application traffic redirects to us-east1 in < 15 seconds.
scenarios.recovery: Global Application Load Balancer shifts all user traffic to healthy us-east1 GKE cluster.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
